tha-ap387:1.1: Phārusaphaladāyaka.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddham āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ / rathiyaṃ paṭipajjantaṃ phārusaphalam adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap387:2.1: Ekanavut' ito kappe yaṃ phalam adadam ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap387:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Phārusaphaladāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
